summary: Abits Group Inc, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice of annual meeting and proxy statement for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the meeting set for December 15, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. EST, virtually. Shareholders of record as of November 12, 2026 — 3,554,439 ordinary shares outstanding — will vote on electing five directors, ratifying Audit Alliance LLP as auditor for fiscal 2026, and approving the 2026 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan. No transaction terms, prices, or advisor mandates are stated. This is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation; watch only for any contested director vote or incentive-plan dilution concerns.
